title: Favorite early bands: the Excelsior
summary: He followed parades and dances; the Excelsior brass band was his favorite.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Can you tell us about any of the early bands that you heard even before you took up music? Did you ever follow any of the parades or go to some of the dances? Oh, yeah.
I went to many of them.
The Excelsior Band was my favorite band.
Who was the leader of that at that time?
I think Manny Parash was the leader of that band at that time.
Anybody else in there that you liked? How did you happen to pick out the drums to play?
